section.step_title: Assemble the Post Bracket and the Pull-to-Open Bracket

content_zh: 将螺栓穿过立柱支架和拉式开门支架上的孔，用垫片和螺母固定，如图所示。注意不要将螺母拧得过紧，因为立柱支架后续可能还需要调整位置。
content_en: Insert the bolts through the holes of post bracket and pull-to-open bracket, and fasten with washer and nut as shown. DO NOT over tighten the nut because the post bracket may need to be adjusted later.

section.step_title: Determine the Position of the Post Bracket Assembly

content_zh: 下表列出了根据尺寸A和B确定的大门最大开启角度。例如，若A为16cm(6.3")、B为14cm(5.5")，则大门最大开启角度为110°。测量A和B的尺寸以确定所需的开门角度，然后标记立柱支架的安装位置中心。拉式开门(Pull-to-Open)安装时，大门处于开启位置，且机械臂活动杆应完全缩回。
content_en: The table shows the maximum opening angle of the gate based on the dimensions of A and B. For example, if A is 16cm (6.3") and B is 14cm (5.5"), the maximum opening angle of the gate is 110°. content_zh: 控制板端子功能整页（第18页）：21 个编号端子（①-㉑）按功能组说明接线用途。
content_en: Terminal Function of the Control Board (page 18): 21 numbered terminals grouped by function.

images.caption: 控制板端子功能表整页

section.chapter_title: Terminal Function of the Control Board

content_zh: 控制板端子功能对照表：①+24、③GND 端子输出24VDC电压为光电传感器供电；②PHOTO、③GND 接收光电传感器信号，常闭(NC)输入；④O/S/C、⑤COM 通过常开干接点信号控制大门循环开/停/关/停，常接推杆开关、有线密码器、外接收器；⑥OPSW、⑤COM 接收车辆检测器常开输出的开门信号；⑦EDGE、⑧GND 接收防夹边缘传感器常开信号；⑨⑩+LOCK- 输出接大门电锁正负极，要求失电闭锁型、额定24VDC、额定电流<3A；⑪⑫+BAT- 输入接24VDC电池或电源正负极，为整个系统供电；⑬⑭ADAPTER 输入接适配器为电池充电，也可接36VDC或24VAC电源；⑮⑯+LAMP- 输出接警示灯正负极，要求额定24VDC、额定电流<1A；⑰⑱+MOTOR- 接机械臂电机红黑线；⑲DLMT、⑳COM、㉑ULMT 接限位开关，近端限位接DLMT和COM，远端限位接ULMT和COM。
content_en: Terminal Function table: (1)+24 (3)GND - Provide 24VDC to power photocell sensors. (2)PHOTO (3)GND - Receive photocell NC signal. (4)O/S/C (5)COM - Open/stop/close/stop cycling via NO dry contact. (6)OPSW (5)COM - Vehicle sensor NO opening signal. (7)EDGE (8)GND - Edge sensor NO. (9)(10)+LOCK- - Electric lock fail-secure 24VDC <3A. (11)(12)+BAT- - 24VDC battery/power input. (13)(14)ADAPTER - Adapter charging; 36VDC or 24VAC. (15)(16)+LAMP- - Warning light 24VDC <1A. (17)(18)+MOTOR- - Motor red/black wires. (19)DLMT (20)COM (21)ULMT - Limit switches; near-end DLMT/COM, far-end ULMT/COM.
